subject: science
concept: Understanding cell specialization: how cells differentiate to perform specific functions in multicellular organisms
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares physical models of differently shaped specialized cells (nerve, muscle, blood) and discusses how shape fits function
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a specialized cell type to the specific job it performs
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described specialized cell's structure fits its function

misconception_flags: believes all cells in a multicellular organism are identical and interchangeable

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
